ming:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel game animation sprite atlas, genuine transparent alpha background. Reference image is identity/style reference. Draw ONLY XIAO MING, the boy in the FIRST ROW: dark purple tousled hair, purple round glasses with clearly visible eyes, mint green collared shirt, lilac shorts, purple white sneakers. Match the reference EXACTLY: same face, proportions, palette, crisp pixel clusters, cute detailed 16-bit pixel art. NO 3D, NO smooth vector or blurred illustration.
Output exactly 1536x1152 pixels, 4 columns by 3 rows, precisely equal 384x384 invisible cells. EXACTLY twelve isolated sprites, ONE centered in EACH cell; no labels, letters, grid lines, decoration or watermark. All sprites SAME SCALE and same foot baseline at cell y=340, center x=192. Entire sprite must fit cell x40..344 y36..344 including raised hands. Keep generous transparent gaps.
Every cell depicts the same full student SEATED on the same simple lavender classroom chair behind a compact pale honey-wood school desk with rounded corners, an open ivory notebook and small pencil on the desktop, knees bent and feet visible below desk. Furniture footprint and perspective EXACTLY SAME in all 12 cells. Front view slightly elevated showing desk top, character face fully visible. Desk width about 250px, total figure plus furniture height about 280px. No floors or shadows beyond small contact pixels.
Actions in strict left-to-right row order: Row1: 1 seated listening eyes open hands on desk, 2 IDENTICAL listening but eyelids closed blink, 3 looking down reading the notebook, 4 writing with pencil in notebook. Row2: 5 thinking chin on hand, 6 raising right hand above head eagerly, 7 answering mouth closed hands on desk, 8 IDENTICAL answering but small open mouth. Row3: 9 slight nod eyes closed, 10 confused head tilted with hand near temple, 11 happy both hands clapping together in front of chest, 12 looking slightly toward left.
Pixel details are beautifully crafted, stepped 1–3px edges, dark plum outlines, restrained highlight/shadow palette, warm expressive eyes and cheeks. No translucent checkerboard pattern: background MUST be actual transparent. The sprite spacing and grid regularity are essential for runtime cropping.
